changes: Group POST messages accepts optional bounded client_request_id in encrypted JSON/multipart. Canonical request JSON plus ordered actual file bytes, names, sizes and content types are SHA-256 bound; random multipart boundaries do not affect the digest. Hashing obeys per-file size limits. Exact encrypted request replay is required; changed ciphertext or files cannot reuse an operation key.

Service membership checks guard prepare, result read, completion and reconciliation. Internal computed RequestHash (not JSON input) binds the service insert to the prepared operation. Existing no-key clients remain on the legacy path; current client has NOT yet opted into idempotency.

Completed POST replays hydrate the current authorized message/attachments/reactions rather than a stored response; they return 201 or indexed 207 without another upload/broadcast/unread increment. Prepared retries contend on the repository fence. Committed unfinished operations return 202, which is not final send success; deleted operations return 410 and cannot resurrect messages.

Authenticated GET /api/group-dms/{groupId}/send-operations/{requestId} is read-only, sender-owned and no-store. Prepared/deleted states have no message. A second membership check protects hydration after revocation. Hashes and owner identity are omitted from operation JSON.

Explicit rate-limited POST .../reconcile preserves committed uploads and finalizes missing file positions as failures after a two-minute grace period, without resending text/files. It retries at most three concurrent attachment conflicts. Repository locking fences remaining old-worker inserts; completed/deleted operations never restart. GET does not perform this mutation.
Route golden and OpenAPI document optional identity, exact encrypted replay, pending vs completed, deletion, partial results, ownership and explicit reconciliation.
verification: Real SQLite handler/service/repository integration tests pass: repeated text POST has one message/read increment/broadcast; cross-user and unauthenticated reads are denied; replay returns edited current content, deletion is 410, removed membership is denied.

Real multipart partial-result replay performs only the original two upload attempts and preserves failed index 0; changed same-length file bytes return 409. Committed pending POST is 202; early reconcile remains pending; old GET remains read-only; explicit old-op reconciliation completes text or returns only missing file indices, fencing a late original upload.
Hash test verifies multipart-boundary independence, file content/order and ciphertext binding plus hard per-file read limits.

Full Linux Go regression go test ./... -timeout=15m exited 0 (repository 34.898s, services 21.213s, handlers 2.766s, database 8.860s). Final no-store/hash follow-up targeted API/service/route tests also passed afterward (handlers 0.732s, services 0.198s, main 0.194s).

OpenAPI parsed through the existing root js-yaml dependency: 223 paths and zero unresolved internal refs. Initial Python/yaml and client-local parser attempts were unavailable; no dependency was installed. Targeted git diff --check passed.
remaining: Client encrypted request retention, operation identity, pending/error UI, lookup/reconcile/retry integration and restart recovery are not implemented yet. Do not claim current app sends are duplicate-free.

A replay hydrates edited current ciphertext, so the client must not stamp its original plaintext/file keys into a newer encrypted message cache version. Account/device/membership/rekey ownership needs dedicated client tests.

Durable WebSocket/outbox delivery after commit-before-broadcast process failure is not implemented. Prepared operation cancellation/retention and interrupted-operation discovery need integration decisions; no existing operation rows were pruned.
